verdict.rationale: Smithery's docs say it handles OAuth with its own managed apps ('Smithery maintains OAuth apps for popular integrations', 'No redirect URIs, client IDs, or secrets to configure'). Nothing in the pack documents bring-your-own OAuth client credentials or custom branding of the authorization flow. The documented hosted Connect service was also shut down on 2026-10-31.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
